footer.aboutText: Founded in 1931 by veteran freedom fighter Shri Amritlal Sheth under Saurashtra Trust, Janmabhoomi launched its daily broadsheet on 9 June 1934 in Mumbai. For over 93 years, it has stood for fearless journalism, public welfare, and trusted regional engagement across Gujarat and Maharashtra.
